TAILON LOCK

The Great Nose2Nose Engagement

Nose-to-nose jet combat. Two jets, one sky, one tanker, and six ground targets on each side of the line.

Your code

Set Match and Players here first. One player creates a game and reads out the code. The other types it in and presses Join. Both of you need this page open on claude.ai, signed in, and your opponent needs access to it: share it with them from the Share menu.

Touch controls

FlyPut your left thumb anywhere on the left side and drag. Up dives, down climbs, sideways rolls.
CannonHold GUN
MissileTap MSL when the diamond turns red
FlaresTap FLR
ThrottleSlide the THR bar on the right edge
View, pauseVIEW and II at the top right

Hold the phone or tablet sideways. A gamepad also works and is used as soon as you touch it.

Tab cockpit or chase view, Esc pause, M sound. In 1 player and online mode both key sets fly your jet. Gamepads work too: stick to fly, A cannon, B missile, X flares, triggers for throttle. A HOTAS (stick, throttle and rudder pedals, together or separate) works after you bind it in HOTAS setup; its hat switch looks around.

Briefing

  • Win by shooting down every enemy jet three times, or by destroying all six of their ground targets.
  • Co-op: fly as wingmen against a CPU squadron with one jet per player. Online, the host's Match and Enemy pilot settings apply to both computers.
  • Keep the enemy in your sight until the diamond turns red, then fire a missile. Missiles also lock onto ground targets.
  • Flares can decoy an incoming missile. A hard turn can break its lock.
  • Refuel and rearm behind the circling tanker at matching speed, or with a slow pass below 500 ft over your own runway.
  • SAM sites guard each base. Come in fast and low, or take them out first.
  • Music: "Full Burn", our own theme, plus our own SID-style sound effects. Tap or click anywhere to start the sound.

HOTAS SETUP

Plug in your stick, throttle and rudder pedals, then press a button on each one so the browser lists it. Every device is read at the same time. Press Bind all and move or press each control when asked. Settings save in this browser and come back when the devices are plugged in again, in any USB port.
